verdicts.quote: All-or-nothing creation and conflict rejection are draft policies to avoid silent partial imports or changes to existing users.
Missing or invalid email, wrong field count or a duplicate candidate key rejects the whole batch. Report the applicable record numbers and reasons, including both occurrences of an in-file duplicate.
If any candidate already exists at the write boundary, reject the whole batch. Report the conflicting record for a conflict the admin may see... Preserve the existing account's attributes.
Uploaded fields cannot assign roles, credentials, account scope or privileges.
An admin with current creation authority for the active scope can reach **Import users**, select or replace one CSV, and explicitly submit it.
verdicts.missing: Whether bulk import needs its own grant distinct from single-user creation authority; the spec ties it to ordinary creation authority and adds no new permission.

verdicts.quote: The header is the first CSV record and must contain exactly the single field `email` after decoding... Each data record has exactly one field.
Use UTF-8 with an optional initial byte order mark, comma separators, and LF or CRLF line endings... Quotes can enclose a field... A quoted line break belongs to its field.

settle default role/status plus provisioning, invitation, or notification effects and their failure contract... If the normal lifecycle has effects that cannot honor the draft failure contract, settle that conflict before enabling writes.
verdicts.missing: What happens to invitations or other side effects already triggered when the batch later fails; left as an open gap.

verdicts.quote: a file over an enforced limit reject the batch before creation with an actionable file error... Numeric ceilings are open.
verdicts.missing: The actual byte and row ceilings.

verdicts.quote: Empty bytes, a header-only file... reject the batch before creation... Check a single quoted record with CRLF and BOM, with and without the final newline.
Repeating a previously committed file produces a conflict with zero additional creations.
No automatic retry, cancellation action, saved import history, background-processing commitment, completion notification or downloadable report is required.
No CSV-specific sign-in, password, invitation or notification policy is specified.
verdicts.missing: Whether invitation mail goes out for every created user at once and any pacing or throttling.

verdicts.quote: have the same default attributes as ordinary creations
verdicts.missing: Active vs pending status, password presence and how the new user first signs in; default role/status is left as an open gap.

verdicts.quote: Other actors cannot read the upload or its detailed result... On terminal processing discard the authority's input and validation intermediates.
compare its ASCII letters case-insensitively using the full address... with no independent internationalized-address policy.
verdicts.missing: Any stated rule for date, number or locale handling; the email-only format only sidesteps it implicitly.

verdicts.quote: Cover denied submissions, validation rejection, confirmed creation, write failure... using a safe operation correlation value, outcome and applicable counts.
verdicts.missing: That the record names the importing actor, the time and which users were created; email values are excluded from diagnostics.

verdicts.quote: The admin may reselect and resubmit the same file as a fresh attempt... No automatic retry, cancellation action... is required.
the UI shows pending throughout an outstanding response... File bytes, row ceiling... response/deadline, resource and cost limits are unresolved.
verdicts.missing: A time bound for a max-size file and any progress indication beyond a single Importing state.

verdicts.quote: Preserve existing users, unrelated scopes, ordinary defaults and established account lifecycle rules.
